svg.aria-label: Cable routes: power slide (trunk and chain)
svg.text: Cable routes: power slide (trunk and chain)
AC3 (230 V) and DO2 (12 V) leave the bay under the guard, run on the glide tray, then through the chain (separator between them) to the pod.
Cable routes: power slide (trunk and chain)
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.13.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
Chain: igus E2.15 R75 lying on its side on the glide tray; fixed end at mid-travel, moving end 115 mm behind the carriage front; length = travel/2 + πR.
Cables in the chain: AC3 2.5 mm² 3-core high-flex (chain rated) and DO2 6 mm² twin high-flex, with an igus separator between them.
Strain relief (tie plates) at both chain ends; 600 mm of each cable is in the chain (included in the schedule lengths).
Inspect with the slide fully out: tray, fixed run, loop and both brackets are open from above.
